title: [2D][PAID] Looking for Character Artist + Background Artist — Gothic Regency-Inspired Visual Novel
content: Hi! I'm looking for two artists for a gothic romance/mystery visual novel set in a fictional, Regency-inspired version of 19th-century England: 1. Character Artist: expressive, stylized 2D character art with a strong illustrative feel (character sprites, expressions, outfit variations). 2. These are two separate paid positions for a commercial visual novel, open for ongoing work rather than a single commission. Contact via topic reply with portfolio link and rates.

title: Looking for Unity VFX Artist experienced with Shaders
content: Hey everyone! I've been developing a 2D arena shooter game with bioelectrical creatures in Unity, for over a year now. I'm looking for a VFX artist to help with development. The game features bioelectric creatures, various gun types from energy-beam weapons to shotguns and rocket launchers, bioelectric shields, dashing + down-thrusting, and enemies that can wander the whole map to chase you. Much of the core art and gameplay is already implemented. I'm looking for someone who can both polish existing art with VFX and add new VFX ($25-35/hr). Open to contacting over private messages on itch.io.
